items.source: Return the name of the aspect (bean) in which the advice was declared.
items.translation: 返回声明该切面的名称（bean）。

items.source: Return the declaration order of the advice member within the aspect.
items.translation: 返回切面中 advice 成员的声明顺序。

items.source: Return whether this is an after advice.
items.translation: 返回这是否为后置通知。

items.source: Return whether this is a before advice.
items.translation: 返回这是否为前置建议。

items.source:
Interface to be implemented by types that can supply the information
needed to sort advice/advisors by AspectJ's precedence rules.
items.translation: 由能够按 AspectJ 优先级规则对建议/顾问进行排序的信息提供类型所实现的接口。
